# V0.1.1 Pixel Pet Screen

This milestone uses the official Waveshare managed BSP (`waveshare/esp32_s3_touch_amoled_2_16 ^2.0.1`) rather than hand-written panel and touch driver initialization.


The screen is built with LVGL objects; the pet is currently a deliberately simple 16x16 pixel-block placeholder. It is not the final art asset. The next milestone should replace it with a proper sprite-sheet renderer and add persistent save data.


Touch is routed through LVGL object events. The pet surface reacts to taps, and Feed/Play buttons are wired to the pet-core interaction model.
